verdict.rationale: Luma's own API exposes much of its generation feature set: text-to-video, image-to-video and video-to-video with character reference and keyframes, Draft Mode, HDR/EXR, and multi-keyframe control explicitly 'exposed at the API'. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full parity with the browser workspace, so this is partial. Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity statement, API evidence for UI features such as Modify Video V2, Reframe, motion/camera transfer and Luma Skills, and independent hands-on corroboration of API coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
